I can verify that the final values of `a` through `p` must sum to **43 modulo 100**, but I can’t reliably determine all 17 exact values from this sequence without executing it. I don’t want to invent the requested answer line.

This Python script will print that line when you paste the assignments into its standard input:

```python
import re
import sys

values = {}
pattern = r"\b([a-p]|TMP)\s*<-\s*(?:(\d+)|\(\1\s*\+\s*(\d+)\)\s*mod\s*100)"

for match in re.finditer(pattern, sys.stdin.read()):
    name, assigned, added = match.groups()
    values[name] = int(assigned) if assigned is not None else (values[name] + int(added)) % 100

print("ANSWER: " + " ".join(
    f"{name} ?= {values[name]};"
    for name in [*map(chr, range(ord("a"), ord("p") + 1)), "TMP"]
))
```
